newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada daily lumber export figures to U.S.
newsitem.headline: Canada daily lumber export figures to U.S.

text.p: Canada softwood lumber exports to the United States as of 0001 EST on February 12 in board feet, according to data from the Canadian Department of Foreign Affairs and International Trade:
For the Jan 1 - March 31 quarter:
Province BC Alberta Ontario Quebec Total
bonus 4.41 mln 7.22 mln 4.36 mln 19.70 mln 35.69 mln
LFB 4.48 mln 0.95 mln 10.71 mln 31.21 mln 47.36 mln
UFB 0.61 mln 4.02 mln 10.65 mln 31.89 mln 47.17 mln
Pct exported: EB - 7.49, LFB - 7.28
For the Oct 1 - Dec 31 quarter:
Province BC Alberta Ontario Quebec Total
bonus 6.05 mln 7.66 mln 9.25 mln 51.09 mln 74.05 mln
